column1: # Tests that read the decoy user-assets.json of tools/test_home_guard.sh without choosing a HOME.
# Why: each one calls identity::identity (src/identity.rs, env HOME), which opens that file through
# home_state::home_go_markers. Under the wrapper that HOME is an empty temporary folder, so no real
# folder is read; the root fix is a separate change (identity takes HOME as an argument).
# Source: one observe run of the whole suite, head 57bcc17de2, nextest 0.9.152, 7320 tests run; the 389
# touching tests, one line each (SPEC-20261123-test-home-isolation D-5).
# This file only shrinks: tests/test_home_guard.rs caps its length and checks every name.
# Format: <test binary><TAB><test name>, sorted without repeats; library tests use the binary moai_cli.
